description: Agent App blueprint: PocketBase backend + React frontend, with an in-process A2App adapter as PocketBase JS hooks. NOT part of the framework.

gate.name: hooks syntax + rules self-test
gate.run: node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_rules.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_impl.js && node --check pb/pb_hooks/_a2app.pb.js && node pb/pb_hooks/_a2app_rules.js --selftest && node scripts/test-triage.cjs

gate.name: operations resolve (every declared op has a runner)
gate.run: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ops=fs.existsSync('operations.json')?(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('operations.json','utf8')).operations||[]):[];const has=fs.existsSync('pb/pb_hooks/operations.js');const r=has?(require('./pb/pb_hooks/operations.js').runners||{}):{};const missing=ops.filter(o=>typeof r[o.name]!=='function').map(o=>o.name);if(missing.length){console.error('declared in operations.json with no runner in pb/pb_hooks/operations.js: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}process.stdout.write('operations resolve ok\n')"
